facts.fact: Official pages differ on whether Stand-Up India is still running: the Department of Financial Services says the scheme period was up to 31.03.2025 (successor scheme for first-time women/SC/ST entrepreneurs announced in Budget 2025-26, EFC note under preparation), while a PIB explainer of 13 June 2026 still describes it in the present tense
facts.was: presented as a currently available scheme
facts.quote: Herein it maynot be out of place to mention that the SUPI Scheme is upto 31.03.2025, in line with the 15th Finance Commission.

also.quote: The scheme facilitates bank loans ranging from ₹10 lakh to ₹1 crore for setting up enterprises across manufacturing, services, trading, and agri-allied sectors.

facts.note: Searched financialservices.gov.in and pib.gov.in (28 Oct 2026): no notice extending SUPI beyond 31.03.2025 and no launch of the successor scheme found. The Finance Minister's Rajya Sabha reply of 22 Jul 2025 (PIB 2146820) describes the scheme in the past tense. standupmitra.in did not resolve (DNS failure).

facts.fact: Stand-Up India bank loans are between Rs 10 lakh and Rs 1 crore, to at least one SC/ST borrower and at least one woman borrower per bank branch, for a greenfield enterprise
facts.quote: Stand Up India Scheme facilitates bank loans between 10 lakh and 1 Crore to at least one Scheduled Caste (SC) or Scheduled Tribe (ST) borrower and at least one woman borrower per bank branch for setting up a greenfield enterprise.

facts.fact: The enterprise can be in manufacturing, services, trading or activities allied to agriculture
facts.quote: For setting up greenfield projects in manufacturing, services or trading sector and activities allied to agriculture;

facts.fact: Eligible: SC/ST and/or women entrepreneurs above 18 years of age
facts.quote: SC/ST and/or women entrepreneurs, above 18 years of age

facts.fact: Loans are only for greenfield projects, i.e. the beneficiary's first-time venture
facts.quote: Loans under the scheme are available for only green field projects. Green field signifies, in this context, the first-time venture of the beneficiary

facts.fact: For non-individual enterprises, at least 51% shareholding and controlling stake must be held by an SC/ST and/or woman entrepreneur
facts.quote: In case of non-individual enterprises, 51% of the shareholding and controlling stake should be held by either SC/ST and/or Women Entrepreneur.

facts.fact: The borrower must not be in default to any bank or financial institution
facts.quote: Borrowers should not be in default to any bank/financial institution.

facts.fact: The loan is a composite loan (term loan plus working capital) of about 85% of the project cost
facts.note: Stated on the Stand-Up Mitra scheme features page, but standupmitra.in did not resolve from the checker on 28 Oct 2026 (DNS failure). DFS confirms only 'Composite Loan between Rs.10 lakh and Rs.1 crore'. Retried in the audit on 28 Oct 2026: still 'Temporary failure in name resolution'.

facts.fact: Interest is the bank's lowest applicable rate for that rating category, not exceeding base rate (MCLR) + 3% + tenor premium
facts.quote: The rate of interest3 would be lowest applicable rate of the bank for that category (rating category) not to exceed (base rate (MCLR) + 3%+ tenor premium).

facts.fact: Repayment is within up to 7 years with a maximum moratorium of 18 months
facts.quote: The repayment period is a maximum of up to 7 years4 with a maximum moratorium period of up to 18 months.

facts.fact: Security is primary security plus collateral or a guarantee from the Credit Guarantee Fund for Stand-Up India, as the bank decides
facts.note: standupmitra.in unreachable (DNS failure). A PIB explainer (static.pib.gov.in/WriteReadData/specificdocs/documents/2023/apr/doc202345178201.pdf) confirms only that 'To extend collateral free coverage, Government of India has set up the Credit Guarantee Fund for Stand-Up India (CGFSI)'. Retried in the audit on 28 Oct 2026: still 'Temporary failure in name resolution'.

facts.fact: Margin money of up to 15% can come in convergence with other central/state schemes, but the borrower must bring at least 10% of the project cost as own contribution
facts.quote: Margin money ‘upto 15%’ which can be provided in convergence with eligible central/state government schemes. In any case, the borrower has to bring in minimum of 10 % of the project cost as his/her own contribution;

facts.fact: Loans can be applied for through the Stand-Up India portal (standupmitra.in)
Registration on the Stand-Up Mitra portal is free of cost
facts.note: Stated in the Stand-Up Mitra FAQs, but standupmitra.in did not resolve from the checker on 28 Oct 2026 (DNS failure). Retried in the audit on 28 Oct 2026: still 'Temporary failure in name resolution'.

facts.fact: PM MUDRA Yojana gives loans up to Rs 10 lakh to non-corporate, non-farm micro/small enterprises, and up to Rs 20 lakh (Tarun Plus) only for those who availed and repaid a previous Tarun loan
facts.was: MUDRA loans up to Rs 20 lakh, open to all including women
facts.quote: for providing loans up to 10 lakh ( 20 lakh for those entrepreneurs who have availed and successfully repaid previous loans under the ‘Tarun’ category) to the non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises.

behaviour: Answers in Hindi. Describes Stand-Up India (Rs 10 lakh-1 crore, greenfield, women/SC/ST 18+, terms) citing standupmitra.in, financialservices.gov.in or PIB. Because DFS says the scheme period was up to 31.03.2025 while a June 2026 PIB explainer still describes it, either is acceptable when the page is cited; noting the 31.03.2025 date and advising to confirm with the bank branch is best. Gives no eligibility or sanction verdict. May mention MUDRA (up to Rs 10 lakh; Rs 20 lakh only under Tarun Plus) as an alternative.
fail_if: Gives an interest subsidy or fixed rate not on the page; says existing businesses qualify; says loans start below Rs 10 lakh; presents the Budget 2025-26 announcement of term loans up to Rs 2 crore for first-time women/SC/ST entrepreneurs as an operational scheme without an official notification; says any first-time borrower can get a MUDRA loan up to Rs 20 lakh; cites unofficial loan sites.
summary: Stand-Up India terms confirmed via PIB FAQ/DFS, but DFS says SUPI ran up to 31.03.2025 (conflict with a June 2026 PIB explainer); MUDRA Rs 20 lakh only for repaid Tarun borrowers; standupmitra.in unreachable so 85%, security and free registration are manual.
